title: Profiles: combining places and access levels
summary: Use the second and third grant rows to combine places, mix access levels, control child jurisdictions, and choose where new records belong.
scenes: More than one grant in a profile
Three places with different access levels
Layered access across region, state and county
Switching profiles and setting Working in

steps.say: A profile can hold more than one place. Select the profile box in the header to open My profiles.
actions: Selects “Profile Master profile Switch ▾ : switch profile or jurisdiction”

steps.say: Choose Create a profile to see how the three grant rows work together.
Under Grants, MERIT gives you three rows of Place, Role, Access, and Include everything under this place.
onScreen: Grants · Each grant is a role, a place, and how much you can do there. Leave a row's place empty to skip it. · Place · (none) · EPA Region 3 · Delaware · District of Columbia · Maryland · Pennsylvania · Virginia · West Virginia · Harford County Health Department · Role · Supervisor · Access · Read only · Read and write (no delete) · Full (read, write and delete) · Include everything under this pla

steps.say: First, make a profile for state-level work in Maryland and Delaware, and add a short description.
actions: Types “Maryland state and Delaware” in Name
Types “State-level cases along the Maryland and Delaware border” in Description (optional)

steps.say: In the first row, choose Maryland for Place, Supervisor for Role, and Read and write without delete for Access.
actions: Chooses “Read and write (no delete)” for Access

steps.say: Clear Include everything under this place on Maryland, so county agencies like Harford County are left out.
In the second row, choose Delaware, keep Supervisor and Read and write without delete, and keep everything under it.
actions: Chooses “Read and write (no delete)” for Access

steps.say: Leave the third Place on none to skip it, then choose Save profile.
onScreen: (none) · EPA Region 3 · Delaware · District of Columbia · Maryland · Pennsylvania · Virginia · West Virginia · Harford County Health Department

steps.say: Next, create a tri-state profile that uses all three Place rows, each with its own access level.
actions: Types “West Virginia, Virginia and Pennsylvania” in Name
Types “Full in West Virginia, write in Virginia, read only in Pennsylvania” in Description (optional)

steps.say: In the first row, choose West Virginia, keep the Supervisor role, and set Access to Full.
actions: Chooses “Full (read, write and delete)” for Access

steps.say: In the second row, choose Virginia, Supervisor, and Read and write without delete.
actions: Chooses “Read and write (no delete)” for Access

steps.say: In the third row, choose Pennsylvania, Supervisor, and Read only, so you can check neighbouring cases without changing them.
Save the three-state profile.
Third, use all three rows to read the whole region, write in Maryland, and have full access in Harford County.
actions: Types “Region read, Maryland write, Harford full” in Name

steps.say: Set the first row to EPA Region 3 with Read only access, keeping everything under it.
Set the second row to Maryland with Read and write without delete, and clear Include everything under this place.
actions: Chooses “Read and write (no delete)” for Access

steps.say: Set the third row to Harford County Health Department with Full access, and save.
actions: Chooses “Harford County Health Department” for Place
Chooses “Full (read, write and delete)” for Access

steps.say: My profiles lists each profile and every grant row inside it, including whether child places are included.
onScreen: Profile What it gives you · Actions · Master profile Master · Everything you have been given. steps.say: Switch to Maryland state and Delaware. Work queues shows the two state tasks, while Harford County stays out.
onScreen: Select all on this page · Task · ⇅ · Queue · ⇅ · Person Case Due · ▲ · Assigned · Select row 1 · Delaware: follow up an elevated child result in Kent County Action level follow-up · Select row 2 · Maryland: confirm a venous result from Cecil County Action level follow-up

steps.say: Switch to West Virginia, Virginia and Pennsylvania, and Work queues shows the three tasks from those states.
actions: Selects “Profile Maryland state and Delaware Switch ▾ : switch profile or jurisdiction”
Selects “Use West Virginia, Virginia and Pennsylvania”
onScreen: Select all on this page · Task · ⇅ · Queue · ⇅ · Person Case Due · ▲ · Assigned · Select row 1 · Pennsylvania: contact a Philadelphia family Action level follow-up · Select row 2 · West Virginia: follow up a Jefferson County result Action level follow-up · Select row 3 · Virginia: review a Richmond child care result Action level follow-up

steps.say: Switch to the layered profile. All eight regional tasks appear, and Intake stays in the menu because Maryland and Harford allow writing.
actions: Selects “Profile West Virginia, Virginia and Pennsylvania Switch ▾ : switch profile or ju”
Selects “Use Region read, Maryland write, Harford full”

steps.say: When a profile covers several places, use Working in on My profiles to pick where new records belong.
actions: Selects “Profile Region read, Maryland write, Harford full Switch ▾ : switch profile or j”
Chooses “Harford County Health Department” for Tenant
onScreen: Sky Region · Harford County Health Department

steps.say: Choose Use beside Master profile whenever you want to return to your full access.
actions: Selects “Profile Region read, Maryland write, Harford full Switch ▾ : switch profile or j”
